name: Electromagnetism.ElectromagneticPotential.time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema
proof:
lemma time_deriv_time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema {A : ElectromagneticPotential d}
    {𝓕 : FreeSpace}
    (hA : ContDiff ℝ ∞ A) (J : LorentzCurrentDensity d)
    (hJ : ContDiff ℝ ∞ J) (h : IsExtrema 𝓕 A J)
    (t : Time) (x : Space d) (i : Fin d) :
    ∂ₜ (∂ₜ (A.electricField 𝓕.c · x i)) t =
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * ∑ j, (∂[j] (∂[j] (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · i)) x) -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 / 𝓕.ε₀ * ∂[i] (J.chargeDensity 𝓕.c t ·) x -
      𝓕.c ^ 2 * 𝓕.μ₀ * ∂ₜ (J.currentDensity 𝓕.c · x i) t := by
  have hAn {n : ℕ} : ContDiff ℝ n A := hA.of_le ENat.LEInfty.out
  have hEs j : ContDiff ℝ 2 (A.electricField 𝓕.c t · j) :=
    electricField_apply_contDiff_space hAn t
  have hEd j := Space.deriv_differentiable $ hEs j
  have hJd := hJ.differentiable $ by simp
  have hg := congrArg (fun f => ∂[i] f x)
    (funext fun y => ((isExtrema_iff_gauss_ampere_magneticFieldMatrix hA J hJ).mp h t y).1)
  unfold Space.div at hg
  simp only [div_eq_mul_inv] at hg
  rw [Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_fun_sum $ fun j _ => (hEd j j).differentiableAt,
    Space.deriv_eq, fderiv_mul_const (LorentzCurrentDensity.chargeDensity_differentiable_space hJd t).differentiableAt] at hg
  simp only [_root_.sum_apply,
    _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, ← Space.deriv_eq] at hg
  conv_lhs =>
    enter [1]
    ext s
    rw [Time.deriv_euclid $ electricField_differentiable_time hAn x,
      time_deriv_electricField_of_isExtrema hA J hJ h]
  rw [Time.deriv_eq,
    (((HasFDerivAt.fun_sum fun j _ => (Space.space_deriv_differentiable_time
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hAn (j, i)) x t).hasFDerivAt).const_mul _).fun_sub
      ((LorentzCurrentDensity.currentDensity_apply_differentiable_time
        hJd x i t).hasFDerivAt.const_mul _)).fderiv]
  conv_lhs =>
    simp only [_root_.sub_apply, _root_.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul,
      _root_.sum_apply, ← Time.deriv_eq]
    enter [1, 2, 2, j]
    rw [Space.time_deriv_comm_space_deriv
      (magneticFieldMatrix_contDiff A hAn (j, i))]
    simp only [time_deriv_magneticFieldMatrix A hAn]
    rw [Space.fun_deriv_sub _ _ (hEd i j) $ hEd j i, Space.deriv_commute _ $ hEs j]
  rw [Finset.sum_sub_distrib, hg]
  simp only [FreeSpace.c_sq, div_mul_eq_div_div, div_mul_cancel₀ _ 𝓕.μ₀_ne_zero]
  ring

name: FieldSpecification.WickAlgebra.ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time
proof:
lemma ι_timeOrderF_superCommuteF_eq_time {φ ψ : 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp}
    (hφψ : crAnTimeOrderRel φ ψ) (hψφ : crAnTimeOrderRel ψ φ) (a b : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra) :
    ι 𝓣ᶠ(a * [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * b) =
    ι ([ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF * 𝓣ᶠ(a * b)) := by
  let C := [ofCrAnOpF φ, ofCrAnOpF ψ]ₛF
  suffices h : (mulLinearMap.comp $ mulLinearMap.flip C).compr₂
      (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ timeOrderF) =
      mulLinearMap.compr₂ (ι.toLinearMap ∘ₗ mulLinearMap C ∘ₗ timeOrderF) from
    LinearMap.congr_fun₂ h a b
  refine ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs' => ofCrAnListFBasis.ext fun φs => ?_
  simp only [LinearMap.compr₂_apply, LinearMap.comp_apply, LinearMap.flip_apply,
    mulLinearMap_apply, AlgHom.toLinearMap_apply, ofListBasis_eq_ofList]
  obtain ⟨A, B, hs⟩ : ∃ A B : 𝓕.FieldOpFreeAlgebra,
      ∀ (l : List 𝓕.CrAnFieldOp),
      (∀ c ∈ l, crAnTimeOrderRel φ c ∧ crAnTimeOrderRel c φ) →
      𝓣ᶠ(ofCrAnListF $ φs' ++ (l ++ φs)) =
      crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ (l ++ φs)) • (A * ofCrAnListF l * B) := by
    refine ⟨_, _, fun l hl => by
      rw [← List.append_assoc, timeOrderF_ofCrAnListF, crAnTimeOrderList,
        insertionSort_of_eq_list 𝓕.crAnTimeOrderRel φ φs' l φs hl,
        List.append_assoc, List.append_assoc, ofCrAnListF_append, ofCrAnListF_append]⟩
  have h0 := hs [] $ by simp
  simp at h0
  calc
    _ = ι (crAnTimeOrderSign (φs' ++ φ :: ψ :: φs) •
        (A * C * B)) := by
      apply congrArg ι
      simp only [C, superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF, ← ofCrAnListF_singleton,
        List.singleton_append,
        mul_sub, sub_mul, mul_smul_comm, smul_mul_assoc,
        map_sub, map_smul, ← ofCrAnListF_append,
        List.append_assoc]
      rw [hs [φ, ψ] $ by simp [hφψ, hψφ], hs [ψ, φ] $ by simp [hφψ, hψφ]]
      simp only [List.cons_append, List.nil_append, smul_sub]
      rw [← crAnTimeOrderSign_swap_eq_time hφψ hψφ φs' φs, smul_comm]
    _ = _ := by
      rw [map_smul, map_mul, map_mul, sub_eq_zero.mp
        (ι_commute_fieldOpFreeAlgebra_superCommuteF_ofCrAnOpF_ofCrAnOpF φ ψ _)]
      by_cases hq : 𝓕.crAnStatistics φ = 𝓕.crAnStatistics ψ
      · rw [crAnTimeOrderSign, Wick.koszulSign_eq_rel_eq_stat _ _ hφψ hψφ
          hq.symm, ← crAnTimeOrderSign, ← ofCrAnListF_append, h0]
        simp only [map_smul, map_mul,
          mul_assoc, mul_smul_comm, C]
      · simp [C, ι_superCommuteF_of_diff_statistic hq]

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius
proof:
theorem fiberwise_dist_lt_imp_dist_lt_unique_decoding_radius (i : Fin ℓ) (steps : ℕ)
    [NeZero steps] (h_i_add_steps : i.val + steps ≤ ℓ)
    (f : OracleFunction 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩)
  (h_fw_dist_lt : fiberwiseClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    (i := i) (steps := steps) (h_i_add_steps := h_i_add_steps) (f := f)) :
  hammingClose 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, by omega⟩ f := by
  classical
  let d := fun j => 2 ^ (ℓ + 𝓡 - j) - 2 ^ (ℓ - j)
  have hid : d (i.val + steps) * 2 ^ steps = d i.val := by
    rw [Nat.sub_mul, Nat.sub_add_eq, Nat.sub_add_eq,
      Nat.pow_sub_mul_pow _ (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le'
        (h_i_add_steps.trans (Nat.le_add_right ℓ 𝓡))),
      Nat.pow_sub_mul_pow _ (Nat.le_sub_of_add_le' h_i_add_steps)]
  obtain ⟨⟨g, hgmem⟩, _, hg⟩ := Nat.sInf_mem
    (s := (fun g : BBF_Code 𝔽q β (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) ⟨i, i.isLt.step⟩ => (fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g.val).ncard) '' Set.univ)
    ⟨_, 0, Set.mem_univ _, rfl⟩
  let Y := fiberwiseDisagreementSet 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps f g
  let e := hammingDist f g
  have hd : e ≤ Y.ncard * 2 ^ steps := by
    rw [Set.ncard_eq_toFinset_card', ← Fintype.card_fin (n := 2 ^ steps), ← Finset.card_univ,
      ← Finset.card_product]
    refine Finset.card_le_card_of_surjOn (fun p => qMap_total_fiber 𝔽q β
      (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, fin_ℓ_lt_r (h_ℓ_add_R_rate := h_ℓ_add_R_rate) i⟩ steps
      (fin_ℓ_steps_lt_ℓ_add_R i steps h_i_add_steps) p.1 p.2) ?_
    intro x hx
    refine ⟨(_, _), ?_,
      (is_fiber_iff_generates_quotient_point 𝔽q β i steps h_i_add_steps x _).mp rfl⟩
    exact Finset.mem_product.mpr
      ⟨Set.mem_toFinset.mpr ⟨x, rfl, (Finset.mem_filter.mp hx).2⟩, Finset.mem_univ _⟩
  have hb : 2 * Y.ncard ≤ d (i.val + steps) := by
    apply Nat.le_of_lt_succ
    change Y.ncard = _ at hg
    rw [hg]
    exact WithTop.coe_lt_coe.mp h_fw_dist_lt
  refine lt_of_le_of_lt (b := 2 * (e : ℕ∞)) ?_ ?_
  · exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (distFromCode_le_dist_to_mem f g hgmem) bot_le
  apply (ENat.coe_lt_coe (n := 2 * e)).mpr
  apply Nat.lt_succ_of_le
  change 2 * e ≤ d i.val
  rw [← hid]
  exact (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 hd).trans (by
    simpa only [Nat.mul_assoc] using Nat.mul_le_mul_right (2 ^ steps) hb)

(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]

name: Binius.BinaryBasefold.fold_advances_evaluation_poly
proof:
theorem fold_advances_evaluation_poly
  (i : Fin (ℓ)) (h_i_succ_lt : i + 1 < ℓ + 𝓡)
  (coeffs : Fin (2 ^ (ℓ - ↑i)) → L) (r_chal : L) :
  let P_i : L[X] := intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i, by
    exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := ℓ+1) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := i.isLt) (by exact Nat.lt_add_one ℓ)
  ⟩) coeffs
  let f_i := fun (x : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
      ⟨i, by exact Nat.lt_trans (n := i) (k := r) (m := ℓ) (h₁ := by omega) (by omega)⟩) =>
    P_i.eval (x.val : L)
  let f_i_plus_1 := fold (i := ⟨i, by omega⟩) (h_i := by omega) (f := f_i) (r_chal := r_chal)
  let new_coeffs := fun j : Fin (2^(ℓ - (i + 1))) =>
    (1 - r_chal) * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2, by
      rw [←Nat.add_zero (j.val * 2)]
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 0) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩) +
    r_chal * (coeffs ⟨j.val * 2 + 1, by
      apply mul_two_add_bit_lt_two_pow (c := ℓ - i) (a := j) (b := ℓ - (↑i + 1))
        (i := 1) (by omega) (by omega)
    ⟩)
  let P_i_plus_1 :=
    intermediateEvaluationPoly 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate (i := ⟨i+1, by omega⟩) new_coeffs
  ∀ (y : (sDomain 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate)
    ⟨i+1, by omega⟩), f_i_plus_1 y = P_i_plus_1.eval y.val := by
  intro P_i f_i f_i_plus_1 new_coeffs P_i_plus_1 y
  let a := (evenRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  let b := (oddRefinement 𝔽q β h_ℓ_add_R_rate i coeffs).eval y.val
  have hq k := generates_quotient_point_if_is_fiber_of_y 𝔽q β i 1 i.isLt
    _ y ⟨k, rfl⟩
  simp only [iteratedQuotientMap_k_eq_1_is_qMap, Subtype.eq_iff] at hq
  simp only [f_i_plus_1, fold, f_i, P_i, evaluation_poly_split_identity,
    Polynomial.eval_add, eval_comp, Polynomial.eval_mul, Polynomial.eval_X, ←hq]
  trans (1 - r_chal) * a + r_chal * b
  ·
    simp only [qMap_total_fiber_one_level_eq 𝔽q β i i.isLt y,
      Submodule.coe_add, Submodule.coe_smul, get_sDomain_first_basis_eq_1]
    simp only [Fin2ToF2, ↓reduceIte, one_ne_zero,
      one_smul, zero_smul]
    ring
  ·
    simp only [P_i_plus_1, a, b, new_coeffs, evenRefinement, oddRefinement,
      intermediateEvaluationPoly, Polynomial.eval_finset_sum,
      Polynomial.eval_C_mul, mul_sum, ←sum_add_distrib,
      add_mul, mul_assoc]
    rfl

name: interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
proof:
theorem interleaved_affine_gaps_imply_tensor_gaps
    (hC_proximityGapAffineLines : e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat
      (F := F) (A := A) (ι := ι) (C := MC) (e := e) (ε := ε))
    (h_interleaved_gaps : ∀ m : ℕ, m ≥ 1 →
      e_ε_correlatedAgreementAffineLinesNat (F := F)
        (A := InterleavedSymbol A (Fin m)) (ι := ι) (C := MC ^⋈ (Fin m)) e ε) :
    ∀ (ϑ : ℕ), (hϑ_gt_0 : ϑ > 0) → δ_ε_multilinearCorrelatedAgreement_Nat (F := F) (A := A)
      (ι := ι) (C := MC) (ϑ := ϑ) (e := e) (ε := ε) := by
  letI : Nonempty F := ⟨0⟩
  refine Nat.le_induction ?_ ?_
  · intro u hp
    have hu : finMapTwoWords (u 0) (u 1) = u :=
      funext (Fin.forall_fin_two.2 ⟨rfl, rfl⟩)
    exact hu ▸ hC_proximityGapAffineLines (u 0) (u 1) (by
      simpa only [← prob_uniform_singleton_finFun_eq (F := F), multilinearCombine₁_eq_affineLineEvaluation, Nat.cast_one,
        ENNReal.coe_one, one_mul, ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp)
  · intro n hn ih u hp
    have hr := prob_R_star_gt_threshold MC u e (by
      simpa only [← prob_split_last_uniform_sampling_of_finFun (F := F),
        multilinearCombine_affineComb_split_last_close,
        multilinearCombine_recursive_form u, Fin.init_def, ENNReal.coe_mul,
        ENNReal.coe_natCast] using hp)
    apply CA_split_rowwise_implies_CA
    apply h_interleaved_gaps _ Nat.one_le_two_pow
    apply hr.trans_le
    apply Pr_le_Pr_of_implies
    intro r hr
    exact correlatedAgreement_of_mem_R_star_tensor MC ih u ⟨r, hr⟩

name: putnam_1964_a4
proof:
theorem putnam_1964_a4
(u : ℕ → ℤ)
(boundedu : ∃ B T : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, B ≤ u n ∧ u n ≤ T)
(hu : ∀ n ≥ 4, u n = ((u (n - 1) + u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) * u (n - 4)) : ℝ) / (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ∧ (u (n - 1) * u (n - 2) + u (n - 3) + u (n - 4)) ≠ 0)
: (∃ N c : ℕ, c > 0 ∧ ∀ n ≥ N, u (n + c) = u n) := by
  obtain ⟨B, T, hB⟩ := boundedu
  obtain ⟨i, j, hij, he⟩ := Finite.wellQuasiOrdered Eq
    (fun n (k : Fin 4) => (⟨u (k+n), hB _⟩ : Set.Icc B T))
  have h (k) : u (k+j) = u (k+i) := Nat.strong_induction_on k fun k ih =>
    if hk : k < 4 then Subtype.ext_iff.mp (congrFun he.symm ⟨k, hk⟩) else by
      rify
      clear hij
      simp (disch := omega) only [hu, Nat.sub_add_comm, ih]
  refine ⟨i, j-i, Nat.sub_pos_of_lt hij, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  rw [← Nat.add_sub_assoc hij.le, Nat.sub_add_comm hn, h, Nat.sub_add_cancel hn]

name: Cslib.SKI.parallelReduction_diamond
proof:
theorem parallelReduction_diamond : Diamond ParallelReduction := by
  intro a a₁ a₂ h₁ h₂
  induction h₁ generalizing a₂
  case refl => exact ⟨_, h₂, .refl _⟩
  case par ha hb iha ihb;
  all_goals cases h₂
  case par.par hc hd =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx⟩ := iha hc
    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := ihb hd
    exact ⟨_, .par hx.1 hy.1, .par hx.2 hy.2⟩
  case' red_I.par | red_K.par | red_S.par =>
    rename_i ha hb
    apply symm
  case par.red_I | red_I.par =>
    cases I_irreducible _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_I _, hb⟩
  case par.red_K | red_K.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, hx, rfl⟩ := Ka_irreducible _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, .red_K .., hx⟩
  case par.red_S | red_S.par =>
    obtain ⟨x, y, h⟩ := Sab_irreducible _ _ _ ha
    exact ⟨_, h.2.2.symm ▸ .red_S .., .par (.par h.1 hb) $ .par h.2.1 hb⟩
  repeat' constructor
  assumption'

name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'
proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  funext x
  by_contra hx
  have hp := real_inner_self_nonneg'.lt_of_ne'
    (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx)
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ => f x) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨φ, hφ, hk, hs, hb, hv⟩ := exists_contDiff_tsupport_subset
    (hc.continuousAt.eventually $ Ici_mem_nhds hp)
  specialize hg _ $ IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨hs, hk⟩ (contDiff_const (c := f x))
  simp only [inner_smul_right'] at hg
  apply ne_of_gt ?_ hg
  apply (hs.continuous.fun_mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero hk.mul_right
  · intro y
    by_cases hy : φ y = 0
    · simp [hy]
    · apply mul_nonneg (hb ⟨y, rfl⟩).1
      exact hφ $ subset_closure hy
  · rw [hv, one_mul]
    exact hp.ne'

name: putnam_1995_a3
proof:
theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  have h {a b} (hab : relation a b) (i) :
      7 ∣ b i * 10 ^ i.1 - a i * 10 ^ i.1 + digits_to_num a := by
    refine (((hrelation a b).mp hab).2 i).trans (dvd_of_eq ?_)
    symm
    rw [hdigits_to_num, ← eq_sub_iff_add_eq, ← Finset.sum_sub_distrib]
    simp only [ite_mul, ite_sub, sub_self, Fintype.sum_ite_eq']
  intro d e f ⟨hde, hef⟩ i
  have hs := Finset.dvd_sum (s := Finset.univ) (fun j _ => h hde j)
  simp only [Finset.sum_add_distrib, Finset.sum_sub_distrib, Fin.sum_const,
    ← congrFun hdigits_to_num] at hs
  apply ((show IsCoprime (7 : ℤ) 10 by decide).pow_right).dvd_of_dvd_mul_right
  refine (dvd_sub (dvd_sub hs (dvd_mul_right 7 (digits_to_num d)))
    (dvd_add (h hde i) (h hef i))).trans (dvd_of_eq ?_)
  ring1

name: Core.InitsUpdatesComm
proof:
theorem InitsUpdatesComm
  {P : PureExpr} {σ σ' σ'' : SemanticStore P}
  {ks ks' : List P.Ident} {vs vs' : List P.Expr} :
  UpdateStates σ ks vs σ' →
  InitStates σ' ks' vs' σ'' →
  ∃ σ₁,
    σ₁ = (updatedStates σ ks' vs') ∧
    InitStates σ ks' vs' σ₁ ∧
    UpdateStates σ₁ ks vs σ'' := by
  intro hu hi
  have := InitStatesLength hi
  refine ⟨_, rfl, updatedStatesInit this (UpdateStatesNotDefMonotone' (InitStatesNotDefined hi) hu)
    (InitStatesNodup hi), ?_⟩
  have := UpdateStatesLength hu
  simp [InitStatesUpdated hi, UpdateStatesUpdated hu, updatedStates]
  rewrite [updatedStatesComm]
  · exact updatedStatesUpdate this $ updatedStatesDefMonotone (UpdateStatesDefined' hu)
  · simp [List.unzip_zip, *]
    intro k hk hk'
    cases InitStatesNotDefined hi k hk' ▸ UpdateStatesDefined hu k hk
